leaves.name: fowlerProp27
leaves.doc: cm-branch, printed form: Fowler, Some uniform effective results on Andre-Oort for sums of powers in C^n, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026) 607-641, Prop. 2.7 (printed pp. 615-616, read by the upstream audit AUDIT.md item 1): for an order R of an imaginary quadratic field k with #Pic(R) <= n (n >= 1), sqrt|f^2 d_k| <= 2 n^2 exp(21000 n^2); no exceptional field. Manuscript L588-593 at n = D.

leaves.name: cmHeight62

(6.2), pp. 13-14 (AUDIT-read: original Faltings metric, Delta = (2 pi)^12 eta^24): for an elliptic curve E/K with an abelian-scheme group model over O_L, h_F^st(E) <= (1/[L:Q]) sum_sigma -(1/12) log(|Delta(tau_sigma)| Im(tau_sigma)^6), tau_sigma a period of E at sigma. glue.name: cmCurveOrder
glue.doc: cm-fibre-split, on-the-spot (diophantine_zq.tex L584-586, "an elliptic curve E/L with complex multiplication", "the full geometric endomorphism order of E"): for an abelian surface A over a number field L with End^0(A_Omega) = M_2(Q(sqrt d)), d < 0, and an elliptic curve E/L with homomorphisms i : E -> A, h : A -> E, h o i = [n] (n >= 1), End(E_Lbar) is isomorphic to an order R of an imaginary quadratic field (corner e End^0 e of a rank-one idempotent; rigidity between algebraic closures). Open; docs/research/cm-fibre-split.md section 4.
